narrative.intro: Fluor Marine Propulsion obligated $4B in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Fluor Marine Propulsion received 2 awards so far this fiscal year, producing an average award size of $2B and obligations that are up 11.9% year over year. Fluor Marine Propulsion saw concentrated buying from two agencies in FY2026 to date: the Department of Defense obligated $2B and the Department of Energy obligated $1.9B. Fluor Marine Propulsion’s recent fiscal history shows steady federal obligations: FY21 totaled $3.1B, FY22 totaled $3.6B, FY23 totaled $3.5B, FY24 totaled $3.5B, and FY25 totaled $3.6B. Fluor Marine Propulsion’s current-year totals are partial, covering fiscal year to date, and the figures presented are contract obligations unless noted otherwise for award-value tables. Readers focused on agency relationships or contract sizing will find that Fluor Marine Propulsion’s FY2026 to date activity is concentrated in very large awards and a small award count, with obligations split nearly evenly between two principal buyers.
